description: Bridges any CONTRACT_UART device into the data matrix as a provider (PROVIDER_UART.MD): frames sent to the port go out on the UART, received UART frames go out of the port.

fields.label: UART device
fields.description: The CONTRACT_UART device ID to bridge

fields.label: RX flags
fields.description: cmd_send_flag of each received message sent out of the port (CMD_SEND_NOWAIT: RX task never waits)
